translations.web: “For, behold, I will send serpents, adders among you, which will not be charmed; and they will bite you,” says Yahweh.
translations.bsb: “For behold, I will send snakes among you, vipers that cannot be charmed, and they will bite you,” declares the LORD.
translations.kjv: For, behold, I will send serpents, cockatrices, among you, which will not be charmed, and they shall bite you, saith the LORD.
translations.asv: For, behold, I will send serpents, adders, among you, which will not be charmed; and they shall bite you, saith Jehovah.
